body:
# CameraView Free **CameraView Free** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows staff to create live camera events through a simple and intuitive GUI. Choose a **host player**, manually select the **viewers**, and start a live spectator session where selected players follow the host’s perspective in real time. ## About This Version This is the **Free version** of CameraView. If you want more advanced features and faster event management, check out the **[Pro Versión](https://polymart.org/product/9519/cameraviewpro)**.
You can support the plugin by making a donation through this link: [https://paypal.me/PabloHernandez601](https://paypal.me/PabloHernandez601)
Join my Support Discord Server
## Features - Simple GUI-based setup - Select a host player - Add viewers manually, one by one - Start and stop camera events easily - Selected players spectate the host in real time - Lightweight and easy to configure - Includes a button in the GUI showing that this is the Free version ## Free Version Limitations - No mass player selection - No automatic inclusion of all online players - Viewers must be selected manually - Advanced features are reserved for the Pro version ## Commands - `/cameragui` — Opens the main camera GUI - `/cam off` — Leaves the camera manually ## Permissions - `cameraview.staff` — Access to the plugin GUI - `cameraview.leave` — Allows leaving the camera manually ## How to Use 1. Open the GUI with `/cameragui` 2. Select the host player 3. Select the viewers manually 4. Start the event 5. Stop the event when finished ![Plugin Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c661ed68cf17428df0816f6c68068cff469bf74.png)
